opportunities.point: The company expects ~70-80% of current power requirements to be met through renewable energy sources.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "~70–80% of our current power requirements are expected to be met through Renewable Energy sources." (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that capacity expansion and higher renewable energy usage are expected to improve operating margins.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Capacity expansion and higher renewable energy usage are expected to improve operating margins" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company commissioned a Solar-Wind Hybrid Power Project with Solar 9.89 MW & Wind 9.90 MW in June 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Solar–Wind Hybrid Power Project Solar 9.89 MW & Wind 9.90 MW Commissioning: June 2026" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The cost of the Unit 4B project featuring 160 water jet looms will be around 35 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "And the cost of this project will be around INR35 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
Management highlighted rising domestic demand for synthetic textiles driven by affordability, durability, and evolving consumer trends.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Positioned to benefit from rising domestic demand for synthetic textiles driven by affordability, durability, and evolving consumer trends" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management noted that over the past few months, demand conditions for polyester yarn have improved and pricing has stabilized.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Over the past few months, demand condition of polyester yarn has improved and pricing are stabilized, reflecting the healthier and more balanced market environment." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)

opportunities.point: The company operates 4 manufacturing units in Surat with a total installed capacity of 39,21,12,000 meters and 20 high-speed water jet looms.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "39,21,12,000 Meter 10 Manufacturing Units in Surat Total Installed Capacity Folding Machines" (concall ppt - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company currently has 39.21 crore metres of total installed capacity.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Today, we have 39.21 crore metres of total installed capacity." (concall transcript - 2026-02-01)
